user_query: I want to organize a charity concert and I need a list of popular songs by women. Can you provide me with the top songs from the Hot 100 Songs by Women chart? Also, suggest some songs by women that can be performed by the artists participating in the concert. Additionally, find out the genre of each song to ensure a diverse lineup.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the top songs by women from the Hot 100 Songs by Women chart.
Identify songs suitable for live performance by participating artists, focusing on songs by women.
Determine the genre of each selected song to ensure diversity in the concert lineup.
